create_dataloader_simmc: create a DataloaderSIMMC instance to load SIMMC dataset with params including data path, encoder type, and domain
load_batch_simmc: load a batch of SIMMC data given sample ids returning utterances, masks, actions, and retrieval candidates
evaluate_response_generation_simmc: evaluate model response generation against ground truth responses using BLEU and ROUGE metrics
evaluate_action_prediction_simmc: evaluate predicted dialog actions against ground truth action annotations
interactive_batch_simmc: generate a batch from an interactive chat input string for single-turn model inference
